title: A real-producer shape in the harness, and the first baseline on it
decision: harness and corpus addition retained, no production change
code_state: no file under crates/ was modified by this batch; the change is confined to tools/perf-baseline and docs/
reason_codes: change 0587 finding 1 names the harness corpora as the first prerequisite of the top half of its ranked queue: the generated worksheets carry no markup-compatibility root, no x14ac:dyDescent, no <cols>, no shared-string part and no worksheet relationships, and change 0032 recorded that explicitly
the new selectors are opt-in, absent from Case::DEFAULT, and add no row to the checked default catalog, so neither catalog_sha256 nor content_set_sha256 moves

the baseline is descriptive: it is the first measurement of the open, selected-cell, planning and one-cell edit/save scenarios on markup-compatibility-bearing input, taken against a byte-comparable marker-free control in the same run

the work uncovered a library fact the survey did not have: the source-backed value-only editor refuses five separate parts of the producer signature, so its reach on Excel output is zero rather than reduced; the refusals are proven at corpus construction rather than asserted

accepted_evidence.determinism: two independent release-mode processes emit byte-identical corpora; the marker census sidecars and the extracted corpus identities are diffed and both diffs are empty
accepted_evidence.eligibility_parity: the generated worksheets and a real Excel fixture trip the same source_stream_eligible conditions (markup-compatibility namespace, x14ac namespace, dyDescent) and both carry <cols> and a shared-string part; the census is produced by the same code path for both
accepted_evidence.refusal_census: one typed refusal per producer fact, each witnessed on the smallest archive carrying only that fact, recorded verbatim in the evidence sidecar
accepted_evidence.timing: 20 warm-ups and 100 samples per selector, pinned to one CPU, with an A/A pair of identical legs in the same window stating the floor, and a marker-free control selector over the same grid
accepted_evidence.real_file: the same open and selected-cell scenarios over a checked-in Excel fixture through the --real-file opt-in, with the file's path, size and SHA-256 bound into the corpus identity

accepted_costs.no_production_change: nothing here makes anything faster; it makes the slow path measurable
accepted_costs.registry_growth: the selectable case registry grows from 441 to 457; every new case is opt-in
accepted_costs.split_family: the XLSX family needs three variants per shape because one archive cannot serve both the read and the edit scenarios; the split is recorded as evidence rather than hidden
accepted_costs.shape_deviation: the measured edit and control variants deliberately omit parts of the producer signature the value-only editor refuses, and the record names each omission and its refusal

known_gaps.sizes: the dense shape is 128 x 128 rather than XlsxShape::DenseWide's 256 x 256, because the markup-compatibility codec makes a 256 x 256 sample seconds long and a 100-sample baseline half an hour per selector
known_gaps.coverage: no producer-shape selector exists for the DOCX or PPTX edit and save scenarios, for the eager XLSX paths, for file-backed or range sources, or for XLSB
known_gaps.catalog: the new generator identities are not added to the schema-2 generator family map, which is the source-audited contract for the default catalog; they retain null algorithm_id and seed_spec
known_gaps.instruments: no callgrind pair, no hardware counters and no allocation profile were taken for this batch

withheld: any speedup, regression, allocation, peak-RSS, cold-cache, physical-I/O, range-source, concurrency or cross-platform result
any claim that the generated producer shape is representative of the real-producer population beyond the eligibility outcomes it is shown to share with one real fixture

provenance.note: seven other measurement agents were active on the host during the run; the A/A leg in the same window is what states the floor
